rgb.precision: float32; no autocast; CUDA matmul/cudnn TF32 disabled
rgb.sampling: inclusive centered time grid; floor(frame_position + 0.5); deduplicated anchors include endpoints
rgb.fps_source: cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS from the source video; invalid FPS is an error
rgb.padding: clamp out-of-range rounded indices to first/last decoded frame; mask and raw indices saved
rgb.alignment: linear interpolation on source frame indices to decoded T; no frame truncation or label access

preprocess.implementation: KINETICS400_V1.transforms(); spatial transform each decoded frame once

rgb.label_policy: Only video_name/frame_count fields of data card are used; no labels or annotations opened

corrected.name: corrected-true-jepa-absolute-patch-v1
corrected.missing_policy: no full-model missing accepted; observed anchor interpolation plus direct/support indicators
corrected.loss_units: V L2 hierarchical error, I normalized-target smoothL1; not directly mixed

training_role: development-trained readout; not independently calibrated; dataset not distributed
